title: Aromatic Snappy Malaysian Blackberry Skillet
description: A savory and umami Malaysian dish featuring blackberries, perfect for a solo dinner, this ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is cooked to perfection on a tava griddle.
instructions: Heat the coconut oil in a tava griddle over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the brine-dried chili flakes, turmeric, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the blackberries and cook until they start to release their juice and the mixture is heated through.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer the mixture for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped cilantro and cook for 1 minute.
Serve the skillet hot, garnished with additional cilantro if desired.
